In her latest BA Bake Club drop, Shilpa makes at least a part of this dream a reality in the form of her Glazed Apple Pie Fritters. They’re studded with tender chunks of apple, and spiced with nutmeg and cinnamon, and yes, deep fried.

Food journalist and podcaster Mark Bittman and his cohost and daughter Kate Bittman from the podcast Food with Mark Bittman stopped by to help coach Kate in the fine art of frying. “Frying dough is kind of benign, right?” assures Mark. “And once it's browned, it's done…so start with that [cue for beginners].” It’s as easy as apple…fritters.

SU: Okay. So, you can use a chopstick to test the temperature of your oil, and you do this by using a wooden chopstick, obviously, not a metal one. You take a wooden chopstick, which is not polished or sealed or lacquered in any way.

If there's a stream of bubbles that immediately rises and they lazily, blub, blub, blub, blub, that means your oil is kind of at the right temperature.
